_comment: ARGO Float Automated Workflow Configuration. Fill in all REPLACE_WITH_* fields before running.
_comment_force_reprocess: Controls reprocessing of existing intermediate files (profile CSVs, .phy, .nc). Options: false = skip existing files (default); true = reprocess all profiles; '181' = reprocess only profile 181; '181-182' = reprocess profiles 181 through 182 (inclusive).

gmail._comment: Download credentials.json from Google Cloud Console, token.json is auto-generated on first run.
gmail._comment_token: Path to token.json (auto-generated on first run after Gmail auth)
gmail._comment_grace: Hours before current time to cut off downloads (avoids partial mid-transmission profiles)

floats._comment: Example float entry — copy this block for each additional float
floats.imei: Used for email filtering to identify relevant ARGO profile notifications
floats._comment_aoml: AOML ID used in .phy filename prefix (e.g. 9184)
floats._comment_wmo: WMO ID used for ARGO RT download URL and nc filenames
floats._comment_broken: 0 = normal (read LGR_CP_PTSCI only), 1 = broken float (fallback to LGR_PTSCI + LGR_CP_PTSCI), used for known floats with LGR CP logging issues to generate intermediate nc files
0 = normal (read LGR_CP_PTSCI only), 1 = broken float (fallback to LGR_PTSCI + LGR_CP_PTSCI)
floats._comment_url: Base URL for real-time ARGO netcdf file download
floats._comment_meta: Path to .meta file used by phy_parser; set to null to skip phy parsing for this float
